name: Loretto Heights Family Apartments (Astraea at Loretto Heights)
award: 2024 Federal 4% and noncompetitive state housing tax credits
headline: Mercy Housing Mountain Plains is building Loretto Heights Family Apartments, now branded Astraea at Loretto Heights, 100 new one- to three-bedroom family apartments for households at 30% to 70% AMI on the former Loretto Heights University campus in southwest Denver. It won a 2024-cycle federal 4% credit plus $800,000 of noncompetitive state credit from CHFA, financed with Denver-issued bonds.
why_it_matters: A Denver 4% deal with a clean public paper trail: city bond inducement, bond ordinance and a $3.78M linkage-fee gap loan with a 60-year covenant, all in Legistar, showing a roughly $44.5M budget for 100 family units.

status.label: Under construction (groundbreaking March 2026, topped out by July 2026); pre-leasing from December 2026
status.detail: Mercy Housing reported the groundbreaking in March 2026 and the topping-off in July 2026, with pre-leasing expected in December 2026 and first residents in March 2027. The bond and loan closing date is not shown in a public record found.

next_step: Watch for the start of pre-leasing in December 2026 and a certificate of occupancy ahead of March 2027 move-ins.

background.text: Denver City Council adopted resolution CR25-0970 on 2025-07-21, stating the city's intent to issue up to $23M of multifamily housing revenue bonds for the project from its private activity bond cap.
Council Bill 25-1226, authorizing up to $23M of tax-exempt Series 2025A and up to $5M of taxable Series 2025B bonds, was passed by council on 2025-09-22 and signed on 2025-09-23.

Council adopted resolution 25-1275 on 2025-09-22 approving the $3,782,000 Housing Stability loan to MHMP 20 Loretto LLLP; the agreement set a loan closing deadline of 2026-06-30 and excluded costs incurred before 2025-06-26.

The site is part of the 70-acre Loretto Heights campus redevelopment, whose rezoning and development agreement with ACM Loretto VI, LLC, the Loretto Heights metropolitan districts and Pancratia Hall Partners was passed as Council Bill 21-0352 on 2021-05-10; the land seller and price for this parcel are not shown in the records found.
Mercy chose the name Astraea, linking it to the Sisters of Mercy and the Sisters of Loretto; the project sits across from Pancratia Hall, a separate 72-unit affordable conversion.
No public document found shows the deal in CHFA's 2024 competitive rounds (Round One applicants, Round Two applicants or awards).

discrepancies.text: CHFA and the city's inducement request give the address as 2934 S Pancratia Street, while the inducement resolution, bond ordinance, loan agreement and Mercy's leasing site give 2980 S Pancratia Street.
